name: expiry_day_pattern_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: F&O expiry days (weekly Thursday for NIFTY/BANK NIFTY, monthly last Thursday for stocks) exhibit distinct intraday patterns driven by options market makers' gamma hedging and pin risk. On expiry day: (1) stocks/indices tend to pin near the strike with maximum open interest ('max pain'), (2) gamma exposure amplifies moves away from max pain in the morning but dampens them in the afternoon, (3) the last 90 minutes see accelerated theta decay forcing option sellers to unwind hedges, creating directional moves. The strategy: trade mean-reversion toward max pain in the morning, then trade breakouts in the last 90 minutes as gamma hedging unwinds. The inefficiency exists because most retail traders trade options directly on expiry day (hoping for lottery payoffs) rather than trading the predictable underlying patterns created by options dynamics.
stock_filter: NIFTY 50 and BANK NIFTY futures — most liquid, tightest spreads on expiry

other: max pain strike (computed from option chain OI)

indicators.name: max_pain_strike
indicators.formula: strike_price that minimizes sum(OI_call * max(0, strike - S) + OI_put * max(0, S - strike)) across all strikes

indicators.name: net_gamma
indicators.formula: sum(OI_call * gamma_call - OI_put * gamma_put) across all strikes

conditions: (expiry_phase == 'morning_pin' AND distance_to_max_pain < -30 bps) — below max pain, expect pin rally
OR (expiry_phase == 'afternoon_unwind' AND close > high_of_last_30_bars AND net_gamma > 0) — gamma squeeze up
long.confirmation: morning: close > close[2] for 2 bars (bounce starting). afternoon: volume_surge > 1.5

conditions: (expiry_phase == 'morning_pin' AND distance_to_max_pain > 30 bps) — above max pain, expect pin pullback
OR (expiry_phase == 'afternoon_unwind' AND close < low_of_last_30_bars AND net_gamma < 0) — gamma squeeze down
short.confirmation: morning: close < close[2] for 2 bars. afternoon: volume_surge > 1.5

exit.target: morning_pin: price reaches max_pain_strike. afternoon_unwind: 30 bps from entry
exit.stop_loss: morning_pin: 15 bps beyond max pain distance (diverging). afternoon_unwind: 15 bps from entry
exit.time_stop: morning trades exit by 13:00. afternoon trades exit by 15:25
exit.eod_rule: flatten by 15:29 IST (absolute last minute before expiry close)
exit.signal_exit: max_pain_strike shifts by >0.5% (OI structure changed, thesis invalidated)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX > 12 AND < 25 (need some vol for gamma effects but not too much chaos)
filters.volume_filter: index futures volume > 1.2x normal (confirmed active expiry)
filters.trend_filter: morning: contrarian toward max pain. afternoon: trend-following breakout
filters.event_filter: ONLY on expiry days (weekly or monthly)
other_filters: skip if max_pain_strike has shifted >1% from previous day's close (unusual OI buildup)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — expiry day patterns are increasingly discussed on Indian trading social media, but the two-phase approach (pin + unwind) is more sophisticated than the simple 'sell options on expiry' strategy most retail traders use.

weaknesses: Max pain calculation requires full option chain data and is sensitive to OI changes during the day. Stale OI data (even 30-min old) can mislead.
With weekly expiries, every Thursday is an expiry day but gamma effects are smaller for weekly options (less OI). Monthly expiry effects are stronger but only 12 per year.
The afternoon gamma squeeze can be violent and fast — if the stop loss is too tight (15 bps), it may get hit before the squeeze completes.
prior_art: Ni, Pearson & Poteshman (2005) 'Stock Price Clustering on Option Expiration Dates'. Avellaneda & Lipkin (2003) 'A market-induced mechanism for stock pinning'. In India, expiry day effects are widely discussed by practitioners but limited academic study exists.
notes: Max pain computation: iterate through all active strikes, for each compute the total loss for option buyers (calls + puts), and find the strike that maximizes total loss. This strike is where option sellers (who are short gamma) benefit most. For weekly expiry, focus on NIFTY/BANK NIFTY only — stock weekly options have too little OI for meaningful gamma effects.
